SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aligned Strike (Su)

A deity’s natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as being aligned to both sides of the deity’s alignment and as being epic for the purpose of resolving damage reduction.

Domain Mastery (Sp)

Athena possesses the Knowledge and War domains. She may use any domain powers and cast any spells associated with her domains at-will. Athena counts as a 30th level cleric for the purposes of domain powers and casting spells.

God of Arms (Ex)

At the start of each round, Athena may choose to use this ability. Athena’s attacks with melee and ranged weapons do not deal damage normally. Instead, each time she breaks a creature’s AC with such an attack, Athena may choose to either have the creature make a DC 44 Fortitude save against L-damage or may instead simply have the attack deal maximum damage. Alternatively, Athena may choose to have all such attacks deal maximum damage automatically.

Semi-Unlimited Wish (Sp)

The deity may cast unlimited wish once per day as a spell-like ability that does not require material components. The unlimited wish may only be in regards to something within the deity’s purview. A god of oceans could cause global draught or flooding, for instance, but could not produce any effect unrelated to oceans.

Warrior of the Gods (Ex)

Athena is a warrior among gods. She’s crossed steel with beings who rule the planes and slain the creatures upon whose bones the world was built. Athena receives a deflection bonus to her AC equal to her divinity score (rather than adding only half her divinity score). Additionally, damage rolls made by Athena ignore an amount of damage reduction equal to Athena’s divinity score. Athena also never takes more than 50 points of damage from any single effect that targets AC or allows a Fortitude or Reflex save
